name: Probability Expanse
briefing: Your own research will rarely have everyone; it will have a sample. Draw random crews from the log and watch how much their averages wander.

log.title: Entry 7: Random crews
log.text: Small random crews give averages that swing widely; larger crews settle close to the full log. That spread has a name, the standard error, and it is what every test from here on measures against.
